# EASI7

> EASI7 is a data-driven digital marketing and technology studio based in Chennai, India. We run analytics, paid media, SEO, content, marketing automation, web/app development, design, and AI solutions as one connected system rather than as separate vendors - so tracking is fixed before media spend, and every piece of work ties back to the same measurement baseline.

## Services

- [Digital Marketing](https://easi7.in/digital-marketing): SEO (technical, on-page, off-page, local, AI SEO/AEO, programmatic), search engine marketing, social media marketing, content marketing, B2B lead generation, email and messaging marketing, marketing automation, analytics and tracking, conversion optimization.
- [Development](https://easi7.in/development): Website development, web application development, e-commerce development, CMS development, frontend development, integrations, web performance and security optimization.
- [Design](https://easi7.in/design): UI/UX design, website design, branding, graphic design, presentation design, video and motion design.
- [AI & Automation](https://easi7.in/ai-automation): AI strategy and consulting, AI agents, AI chatbots, AI-powered marketing automation, business process automation, AI analytics.
- [Strategy & Consulting](https://easi7.in/strategy-consulting): Digital strategy, marketing strategy, growth strategy, MarTech consulting, analytics consulting.
- [Full services index](https://easi7.in/services): every individual service EASI7 offers, organized by category.

## Apps & Tools

- [Apps & Tools](https://easi7.in/apps): Small, self-hosted tools EASI7 built to solve its own operational problems first, before offering them to clients - including a LinkedIn content system, a UTM/tracking platform, a personal finance app, and a B2B intent-signal engine.
